relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a woman with genetically confirmed Alexander disease: "Confirmatory genetic testing identified a pathogenic mutation in the glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) gene"; her daughter is also stated to have Alexander's disease.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. No GFAP variant description is printed, so the patient's variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported' with pathogenicity 'pathogenic' from the authors' sentence. The daughter ('her daughter was also diagnosed with Alexander's disease') is included as an in-scope affected relative with no other individual-level detail; no variant row for her because the paper does not tie a GFAP variant to her. Father and mother are described only with unrelated conditions (cerebrovascular accidents; beta-thalassemia trait etc.), not tested or affected, so they get no rows. Possible tension: 'the lack of a family history of neurodegenerative disease' (around 2017) versus the daughter's Alexander disease diagnosis (timing not given); recorded both as written. Orthopnea reported 'By 2021' and 'did not experience ... shortness of breath' at the preoperative evaluation are at different times; both recorded, not treated as a contradiction for the checklist (no checklist item affected). Spasticity/pyramidal checklist item marked observed from hyperreflexia and positive Hoffman sign; autonomic dysfunction marked observed from nocturnal urinary incontinence (bladder dysfunction). Not recorded as features: laboratory values outside the printed normal range in Table 2 (e.g. hemoglobin 9.5, WBC 10.54), which the authors do not interpret; 'alert and oriented'; 'did not develop this complication' (referent ambiguous). Table 1 is a general subtype table, not about this patient. Age at diagnosis of Alexander disease is not stated (only the year, early 2022). No MRI findings reported.
